title: Migrate and validate the summarize request example
objective: Make summarize an explicit generic request example while preserving specialized path/content source behavior, output formats, and compatibility. Contract sections: requests/README.md#prompt-schema-and-summarize-compatibility; requests/README.md#additional-input-files. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: WI-0021-summarize-request-example
branch.rationale: Processing moved from the shared llm-request-lookup branch (merged to master) to a dedicated per-work-item branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.
